art.subject: Lesser Scaup (Aythya affinis), adult male in winter plumage, as worn from October to April: head and neck black with a purple gloss in good light; breast black; back and scapulars pale grey with coarse dark wavy vermiculation; flanks white with faint grey vermiculation; rear end and tail black. Bill pale blue-grey with only a very small black nail at the tip; iris bright yellow; legs and feet grey.
art.pose: swimming on calm water, side view
art.scene: Korean estuary or coastal reservoir in winter, calm water under a pale grey sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male in winter plumage, swimming, side view: small black head peaked at the rear crown, bright yellow iris, blue-grey bill with only a small black nail, black breast, pale grey back with dark vermiculation, whitish flanks, black rear end and short tail held low

adult female, swimming, side view: small dark brown head peaked at the rear crown, white patch at the base of the bill, yellow iris, blue-grey bill with a small black nail, dark brown breast and back, paler brown flanks

adult male, in flight seen squarely from above: head, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, white wing-stripe on the secondaries only, the primaries without white, pale grey back, black head, breast and rear end
art.build: Medium-small diving duck, slightly smaller than a Tufted Duck, compact and short-bodied. Head small and narrow with a peaked crown, the highest point behind the eye; no crest. Bill shorter than the head, broad and flat, with only a tiny black nail at the tip. Short grey legs set far back. In flight a white wing-bar across the secondaries that turns grey on the primaries. Tail short and dark, held low on the water.
avoid: Do not paint a large rounded head with green gloss and a wide black nail on the bill — those are Greater Scaup (Aythya marila) traits.
Do not carry the white wing-bar onto the primaries; in Lesser Scaup it is white only on the secondaries.
Do not give it a crest or a black back like Tufted Duck; the back is pale grey with dark wavy lines.
Do not paint a dark eye; the iris is bright yellow.
